commit.message:
Fix typo in early exit check

There's a small typo in `StackOverflow::enable_stack_reserved_zone`,
where the method exits early when the reserved zone is disabled instead
of when then the reserved zone is not disabled.  This leaves the
reserved zone writeable beyond the processing of the method annotated
with `ReservedStackAccess`.

This patch fixes the condition and introduces a gtest, since it's easier
to verify the state using a gtest than trying to infer the state using
an end-to-end jtreg test.
